analysis_md:
方程整理为

$$
\left(\frac{y^2}{(x-y)^2}\,dx-\frac{x^2}{(x-y)^2}\,dy\right)-\frac{1}{x}\,dx+\frac{1}{y}\,dy=0,
$$

即

$$
-d\frac{xy}{x-y}+d\ln|y|-d\ln|x|=0,
$$

可得

$$
d\left(-\frac{xy}{x-y}+\ln\left|\frac{y}{x}\right|\right)=0.
$$

$$

$$
